findings.title: Eating makes dependence bodily visible
findings.claim: The pair's eating makes their dependence bodily visible: the messenger and his mother are shown as receivers of food within ordinary creaturely life.
findings.mechanism: The dual eating carrier at 5:75:15:1 meets the food/provision carrier at 5:75:16:2 and the supplied messenger-eating and feeding parallels at 21:8, 25:7, 26:79, and 6:14. Their contact changes eating from incidental biography into a material dependence relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The food clause becomes a concrete test of embodied need while the plain statement about the pair remains intact.
findings.containment: The finding concerns bodily dependence and received food. It does not erase the messenger and truthfulness predicates or add a claim about every form of nourishment.

epistemic.reason: The focus carriers and trusted whole-expression support are explicit; the dependence relation is an interpretive synthesis bounded by the supplied food and messenger parallels.

findings.title: Clarity opens a fork in reception
findings.claim: The doubled look exposes a fork after clarity: manifest signs can be received into recognition and embodied witness, or met by sensory closure and directional reversal.
findings.mechanism: The exact HFT trace joins the focus looks at 5:75:17 and 5:75:23, clarification at 5:75:19, and diversion at 5:75:25 to blindness and deafness at 5:71:5, 5:71:6, 5:71:12, and 5:71:13, then to hearing, eyes, tears, recognition, truth, and denied signs at 5:83:2, 5:83:8, 5:83:9, 5:83:13, 5:83:15, and 5:86:4. The contact changes the repeated look from an assumed correction into an inspection of divergent reception.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why clarity is followed by a question about turning: exposure opens reception, but the response can still close or reverse.
findings.containment: The focus's clarification and passive diversion remain intact. The sensory sequence is attributed HFT evidence, and it does not claim that the ayah explicitly diagrams one community or that visibility compels assent.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace supplies all stated coordinates, focus returns, and a revised before/after reading, while the reception fork is an attributed synthesis and most context branches have no independent lexical record.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Görme ya da anlama amacıyla göz veya zihinsel dikkat bir nesneye yöneltilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The two focus imperatives carry directed sight or reflective attention toward the clarified signs and their reception.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The HFT sensory and recognition coordinates supply contrasting outcomes for the attention invited by the focus.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated look meets both receptive and closed sensory paths, making attention the hinge at which different responses become visible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Looking is perceived as inspection of a reception fork rather than a guarantee of correction.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus commands attention; the divergent sensory application remains attributed HFT inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam şeyin görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus clarification form carries evidence being made manifest and understandable.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The HFT contrast between sensory closure and recognition of truth supplies the separate reception test.
branch_activations.activation: Manifest clarity meets divergent uptake, so making evidence open becomes the condition under which reception can fork.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Clarification is perceived as opening the encounter without mechanically determining its result.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus says that signs are clarified; the later reception outcomes remain attributed contextual evidence.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey tersine çevrilir ve ait olduğu ya da yönelmesi gereken doğrultudan uzaklaştırılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The passive diversion form carries the focus recipients being turned away from the proper direction.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The HFT closure and denial coordinates supply the failed reception path after evidence is exposed.
branch_activations.activation: Directional reversal meets the sensory closure and denied-sign path, making diversion the terminal form of failed uptake in the attributed sequence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final passive question can be perceived as the reversal branch of the reception fork.
branch_activations.boundary: The passive form withholds the agent and does not identify diversion with one particular sensory or social act.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed repeated loss-of-sight occurrences carry closure of the visual route.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus looks and clarification supply the open visual-attentive route against which closure is read.
branch_activations.activation: Loss of sight meets the focus invitation to inspect clarified signs, making one reception branch a closure of seeing.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's directed look is perceived beside a supplied path in which visual access closes.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is unresolved and attributed; no claim is made that the focus audience is literally blind.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed repeated loss-of-hearing occurrences carry refusal to listen.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus looks and clarification supply the receptive route that the attributed context closes.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus reception question is perceived beside a supplied path in which listening closes.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is unresolved and attributed; no literal auditory diagnosis is assigned to the focus recipients.

branch_activations.activation: Receptive hearing meets clarified signs, opening the successful side of the fork.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Receiving the signs is perceived as a response that can move toward understanding.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is unresolved and attributed; the focus does not explicitly state this later response.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The receptive hearing and focus clarification supply the route from evidence to embodied response.
branch_activations.activation: The eye meets hearing and clarified signs, making reception visible beyond inward understanding alone.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The successful side of the fork can become bodily observable.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is unresolved and attributed; no bodily response is asserted for the focus figures.

branch_activations.carrier: The HFT-attributed overflow occurrence carries reception exceeding inward containment and becoming visible.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied eye response and focus clarification provide the distinct opening of evidence into embodied reception.
branch_activations.activation: Overflow meets visible reception, making the successful branch perceptible as an outward consequence of disclosed truth.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The fork includes a reception that exceeds private cognition and appears in the body.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is unresolved and attributed; the finding does not claim that tears are required for recognition.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus signs are perceived as capable of reaching recognized truth when reception remains open.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is unresolved and attributed; the focus does not independently establish this later endpoint.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel anlam, bir seyi tanitan veya ona delalet eden gorunen belirtidir.

branch_activations.activation: The sign meets both recognition and denial, closing the reception fork with a supplied example of evidence that remains rejected.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's clarified signs are perceived as open to recognition yet still vulnerable to denial.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is the supplied visible-sign facet; the context comparison remains attributed and does not make denial the focus's only outcome.

friction_notes: All 21 supplied candidates were reviewed exactly once. Ten decisions retain evidence directly or through one represented finding; nine unanchored HFT summary candidates fail the coordinate-level carrier, independent-trigger, and focus-return test.
The focus word alignment reports 27 of 27 words resolved and no unresolved analysis units. No additional word-level uncertainty was available to qualify the retained focus carriers.

Connection rows supply exact target Arabic and relation notes but no target morphology. They are used as contextual support and boundary evidence; no target lexical branch is invented.

The five exact HFT traces retain unresolved context branches with null gloss and facet fields, using application_mode attributed and preserving the stated HFT role, changed reading, alternative, and boundary in the finding.
No candidate record supplied semantic_obligations or required_branch_facets fields, so semantic_obligation_refs and exclusion arrays remain empty; no supplied obligation was silently dropped.

The branch registry contains many uncandidate focus branches. None beyond the retained candidate-owned relations met the independent carrier, trigger, changed-reading, reader-payoff, and boundary test, so no exhaustive negative inventory is emitted.

The 5:76 retrospective support is represented by the wider dependence-test finding because it repeats the same bodily-intake-to-independent-harm-and-benefit relation; both supports remain cited there.
